protocol_scope: 2026-07-28 and specifically negotiated earlier versions, trace-only verification by RISU Probe
qualification_policy: Only genuinely executed, pinned before/official-fix upstream cases with independently verified causal outcomes count as reproduced. A failure to execute or an ambiguous result is UNVERIFIED, not positive or negative. For every reproduced case, score whether frozen RISU identifies a relevant discrepancy on BEFORE and does not report same on AFTER. Report true mismatches separately from attributed server errors and opt-in behavior oracles. Normal controls counted separately. No rule tuning after observing results.
transport_policy: Original JSON-RPC bytes only when captured unmodified from runtime; if an adapter constructs JSONRPC envelopes around actual upstream function/SDK results, label ADAPTER_RECONSTRUCTED and do not claim live stdio capture.
safety: Public fixed Git trees, commit and blob verification, synthetic-only data, no access to users, credentials or remote production endpoints; never invoke third-party code in pull_request-triggered workflows; set network-free service behavior, no secrets; bound calls/timeouts.

cases.reproduction: Real PHP SDK CallToolResult of explicit JSON null serialized; also test omitted-vs-null and false, zero, empty normal controls
Real Go MCP server validation of RawStructuredContent with an invalid type; clean input and normal valid output control, preserve exact SDK return. Also verify large raw odd int if feasible.
cases.candidate_rule: RMC502 or an explicit UNVERIFIED output-validation state

cases.reproduction: Actual proxy list handler receives a nextCursor and forwards to real/mocked remote session, capture whether cursor advanced. All four methods same root cause counts once
cases.candidate_rule: CATALOG_CURSOR_CYCLE or INCOMPLETE_CATALOG_PAGINATION, only if actually observed in recorded trace

cases.reproduction: Actual upstream tool error formatting of Markdown-active synthetic string; compare raw error content, check generic unmodified normal
Actual upstream enrichment trailer with Markdown special characters; evidence is tool output text versus expected copyable value
Actual Rust CLI JSON output loses structuredContent; compare genuine wrapper result against structured backend input
cases.candidate_rule: UNSCOPED_FOR_TRACE_ONLY unless provided paired original before-wrapper payload

cases.reproduction: Real AG2 MCPToolkit against synthetic two-page tools/list; one-tool first page and second-page tool, control single page
cases.candidate_rule: INCOMPLETE_CATALOG_PAGINATION on observed protocol exchange, not proof of client intent

no_cherry_picking: Do not drop reproducible misses or count multiple triggers of one source defect as separate families. Do not count altered or injected behavioral outputs as actual upstream defects.
